messages:
Maria: Quick sync — Q3 DevEx planning. Need to decide priorities across SDK stability, updated quickstarts, and 3 sample apps (chat, embeddings search, reranker). Customer asks + platform debt both on the table.
Kevin: Agenda? My read: 1) customer-driven bugs (high touch) 2) SDK refactor for async/streaming 3) sample apps to showcase Dedicated/private flows.
Ash: FYI, SDK refactor is ~3 dev-weeks for core auth + streaming wrapper, +1w for e2e tests. Main risk: breaking changes to existing customers if we change auth flow.
Sophia: From interviews: adopters want a 'migration guide' and a hosted quickstart that runs in <5min. Sample apps help but docs need runnable CI.
Jamal: Telemetry shows SDK error rate spikes on large responses (>=8k tokens) — likely KV cache edgecases. If we prioritize stability, we reduce support load quickly.
docs-bot: Backlog link: https://rwd.internal/boards/devex/backlog — contains 18 SDK tickets, 7 quickstart tasks, 4 sample-app stories.
Maria: Proposal: split into 2 tranches: (A) Stability & migration (critical customer asks); (B) Developer enablement (quickstarts + showcase apps). Triage policy: any customer-blocking bug -> hotfix, else schedule into tranche A. Thoughts?
Kevin: +1 on tranches. We should protect a small bet for a new sample app that highlights Dedicated routing (customers ask about cost/latency). Can we do a minimal demo? :eyes:
Ash: Minimal demo plan: containerized chat app that toggles routing policy (hosted vs dedicated). Code is ~300 LOC. We can reuse existing runtime client. Dev estimate: 1.5w.
Sophia: Launch criteria suggestion for quickstarts/sample apps:
```
- Quickstart: runnable in <5m, CI passes, uses sample dataset (<=5MB)
- Docs: migration guide for breaking changes, changelog entry, deprecation window >=30 days
- Sample apps: live demo video + README + minimal infra terraform
```
Jamal: Add monitoring/alerts to sample apps so we don't ship blind. Minimal: error rate, avg latency, token cost per request.
Maria: OKRs tie-back: reduce SDK-reported errors by 40% (Q target), increase quickstart completion rate to 60% within first session. Kevin, can you sketch measurable targets?
Kevin: Draft OKRs:
- DevEx-O1: Reduce SDK error rate by 40% (baseline=3.2% -> target=1.92%)
- DevEx-O2: Increase quickstart completion to 60% across new signups
- DevEx-O3: Ship 2 sample apps (chat + embeddings-demo) with CI and hosted demo
Owners: Ash (SDK refactor), Sophia (quickstarts + UX), Maria (sample apps + rollout).
Ash: For the SDK changes, prefer a non-breaking canary release: publish v2.alpha -> opt-in, then v2 stable after 3 weeks of telemetry. Implementation snippet for auth shim:
```
// shim to support v1 and v2 tokens
if (process.env.RW_SDK_MODE === 'compat') {
  // use legacy auth
} else {
  // new token flow with refresh
}
```
Sophia: We should update quickstart templates to include notes for Dedicated/private networking (VPC example). I'll add a short checklist.
Maria: Action items:
- Ash: create RFC + timeline for canary release (due EOD Thu)
- Sophia: quickstart checklist + sample infra examples (due Tue)
- Kevin: finalize OKRs and target metrics (due Mon)
- Jamal: define monitoring signals for sample apps (due Wed)
Maria: If no objections, I'll book a 30m follow-up on Friday to lock priorities and resource commitments.
Kevin: No objections. Book it. :thumbsup:
Ash: Sounds good. Will start the RFC draft.
Sophia: I'll pair with Ash on migration guide outlines.
Jamal: Will map alerts to existing dashboards.
deploy-bot: Reminder: please link PRs to the relevant devex board item for automatic deployment gating.
Maria: Thanks everyone — we need to keep this lean and customer-focused. Follow-up meeting invite should include rough phasing doc.
